ledger_title: NX-T R2 recovery rec2 (resume of the aborted rec1 attempt)
agent: the NX-T R2 rec2 engineering agent (Sonnet)
reason: The rec1 column attempt was ABORTED on 2026-10-17 at about 13:42Z by a coordinator action, not by the cell: registering the serving task SAEA-Serving-THINKB7 for the next flight started a second server, the serving entry's start-up reaper killed the resident THINKB server under the open flight, the driver saw "Remote end closed connection" on a Solver contact and aborted the attempt at 172 calls / 481.5 speech-seconds with its complete rows checkpointed and its trace present.
root_cause: A coordinator error, not a harness, serving-geometry or owner action: the serving-task registration helper registers AND starts a task and the serving entry script's unscoped start-up reaper killed the resident server of the open flight; the harness behaved as designed (a lost server aborts the attempt)
fix: None required in code: the harness is unchanged between the rec1 flight commit 9790c071f and this registration for the modules a checkpoint resume compares. The standing rules from the incident: no serving or monitor task is registered or started while a flight is open, and serving tasks are created only by scripts/flights/batch/serving_swap.sh.
decision: coordinator brief on the owner's message, translated from Chinese: just resume from the checkpoint
resume_mode_basis: the runtime, runner and row_checkpoint modules are byte-identical between the rec1 flight commit 9790c071f and this registration, but the launch-time checkpoint reader refuses the rec1 checkpoint for the rec2 attempt: row checkpoint $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/runs/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NXT-R2-THINKING-BUDGET-FOLD-B-V1/attempt-slurp-native-stage3-nxt-r2-thinking-budget-fold-b-generation-rec1-v1/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NXT-R2-THINKING-BUDGET-FOLD-B-V1.rows.ckpt.jsonl was written for protocol_hash 'f30958b8ade762b6cf9ccf090d90313d164d5f309547978c30b9a129d6e109ac', not '87c8551b7674ad9c9dd89970366263a9589b9536bd9cb44a133c4ae04e7fdb9c'; a resume applies only when the code, config and split are unchanged. The protocol hash covers the whole experiment fragment, including the cell's attempt id, so a new attempt id of the same cell can never present the header's protocol hash (f30958b8ade7... against the rec2 87c8551b7674...). The trace pin has no such binding and its complete-row set equals the checkpoint's (same kept-row id hash).
